layers.name: Measurement

real: every file and result of the project is sealed in it
ledger.does: Seals every file and result with a hash and a signature, so later changes are detected.

real: verifies the real ledger in Chromium and Firefox
browser_verify.does: Repeats the ledger check inside the visitor's browser, with no server to trust.

real: NASA files re-downloaded with identical hashes
vault.does: Keeps primary NASA files and source tables apart from derived results, by tier.

black_box.does: A portable sealed package of one experiment's evidence (design only).

real: proof sheets matched to archives file by file
deviations.does: Records every disagreement between sources as an issue with its location, never silently corrected.

prov.does: Exports the ledger in the W3C PROV-O standard, readable by other provenance tools.

transfer_engine.does: Decides whether a finding may inform another case, and names the gate that blocks it.

evidence_graph.does: Shows sources, claims and conflicts of the PMMA-100 case as a graph.

real: all 129 rows of the NASA table ranked
comparable_runs.does: Ranks every run of the NASA table by how close its recorded conditions are to a reference run.

real: gates computed for the four measured runs
regime_gates.does: Computes the comparability gates of two runs from their measured values.

real: predictions sealed, then tested on runs acquired afterwards
heldout.does: Writes a prediction down and seals it before the data are opened, then scores it.

literature.does: Finds which papers address a question; relevance only, never comparability.

synthesis.does: Summaries in which every sentence must cite existing records and every number must appear in them.

real: PSI-25 BASS-II files acquired and re-acquired
nasa_data.does: Downloads NASA PSI files, records their hashes, and keeps the inventory of what exists.

real: four runs measured from raw stills
front.does: Measures the flame front position in each raw image and fits the spread rate under a frozen rule.

uq.does: Separates statistical uncertainty, analyst choice and unknown physical effects.

real: the NASA table and the four runs
anomaly.does: Flags gaps, saturation, flicker and suspect table values, with declared thresholds.

real: theory compared with the four measured runs
cram1.does: Computes the thin-fuel theoretical spread rate from sourced PMMA properties.

real: regime groups for the flows of the measured runs
cram2.does: Places a run in the thermal, kinetic or radiative regime from Damköhler and radiation numbers.

cram3.does: Nonlinear dynamics of the flame front (design only).

flow_cal.does: Converts the air display value to flow speed with NASA's fan calibration.

families.does: Identifies the other NASA combustion investigations and keeps them separate, not pooled.

research_control.does: Rebuilds every release result with one command and checks it, byte for byte, against the fingerprint sealed in the ledger.
real: four runs re-measured from raw stills, 30 of 30 outputs identical

memory.does: One searchable record of results, decisions, issues and failures, each with its evidence.

analysis_records.does: A full written record of one analysis: inputs, rule, result, corrections.

blind.does: Other analysts measure the same data without seeing GFL's result; their code is re-executed.

real: AI claims ranked by re-execution on B6
ai_findings.does: Ranks AI claims by what re-execution and the data showed, not by model confidence.

ai_query.does: Lets an AI client question the memory, ledger, ranking and transfer engine, read-only.
real: the real memory and ledger, queried by an independent client
four sealed predictions scored on runs acquired afterwards
predictive.does: Proposes a rate for an untested run from a law with a stated domain, and scores it after the run is measured.

real: the parameters behind the theory and regime results of the measured runs
parameter_registry.does: Lists every model and parameter with its source and shows which model each parameter moves.

real: NASA's records of the 24 PSI combustion investigations
evidence_map.does: Maps which investigations give evidence for each fire-safety function and decides, by fixed rules, between which a finding may be carried.

oxygen.does: Measures how strongly the spread rate depends on oxygen, from runs at two oxygen levels.

tour: nasa_data
NASA photographed a thin plastic sheet burning on the Space Station. GFL downloads the original photos and writes down a fingerprint of every file, so anyone can check they are the same bytes.
ledger
Each fingerprint goes into a signed ledger. Nothing in it can be edited afterwards: a mistake is corrected by a new entry, and the old one stays visible.
front
In every photo GFL finds where the bright edge of the flame is. Edge position against time gives the spread rate, in millimetres per second. The rule for which photos count is fixed before the fit.
flow_cal
The rig shows a fan setting, not an air speed. GFL converts it with NASA's own calibration and says what stays unknown: the speed right at the sample.
uq
How sure is the number? Three layers, kept apart: scatter of the photos, the analyst's choice of what counts as the edge, and physical effects nobody has a bound for.
cram1
What does combustion theory expect for this sheet? GFL computes it from published material properties and puts it next to the measurement.
cram2
Is the flame in the regime where heat transfer alone sets the rate, or near a limit where chemistry or radiation takes over? That decides how far a result can travel.
regime_gates
Before a result from one run is used for another, GFL compares their conditions one by one, from the records. Unknown never counts as the same.
transfer_engine
A deterministic engine then says whether the finding may inform the other case, and names the condition that blocks it when it may not.
heldout
The honest test: GFL writes down what a run should show, seals it with a time stamp, and only then opens the data. One prediction held, one did not; both are shown.
blind
Other analysts, human-directed AI models, measure the same data without seeing GFL's number. GFL re-runs their code instead of trusting their reports.
memory
Everything is kept in one searchable memory: results, decisions, open issues and the errors, ours included.
